title: Velo Client 1.4: a whole new Velo
summary: A new launcher design, new in-game menus with live previews for every module, and Velo World - a game to explore right on your Home page.

blocks.text: **Velo Client 1.4** is our biggest redesign yet: the launcher and every in-game menu got a new look, modules show you what they do before you turn them on, and Home has a whole world hidden in it.

blocks.caption: The new Home: your skin on an animated night-time horizon.

items: **New Home** with a moving night sky, your skin standing on the ridge and your last profiles one click away
**Sidebar navigation**, new fonts and calmer colours on every page
**Updates** now open a proper window with what's new and **Restart to update**
**Friends**: the chat opens next to your friends list, so every button stays in reach
Faster Store, a scrollable version picker, and a **Kill** button when a game doesn't close

blocks.caption: Press W, A, S or D on Home and the horizon becomes a world.

items: A side-scroller right in the launcher: forests, deserts, caves, villages, dungeons and **hard bosses**
Water and lava that really **flow** - dig under a pool and it drains; you can swim (even in lava, briefly)
Craft at a workbench, mine your way down, and meet the trader once you have an **iron pickaxe**
**Play together**: everyone in your party joins the same world
Snake and Blockfall are in there too, with new, calmer music and separate music and sound volume

blocks.caption: Right Shift: every module one click away.

items: Opens on **All** modules; **one click** opens a module
Switch between **big cards, compact cards and a list**
A clear **Edit HUD** button to move and resize what's on screen
The scrollbar can be dragged now

blocks.caption: Hit Particles and Old Animations, previewed with your own settings.

items: Every module that changes how something looks shows it next to its settings: **hit particles, old animations, low fire, item physics, block outlines, crosshairs, HUD elements** and many more
Previews use **your settings** - change a colour or a slider and watch it change
Cosmetic modules you switch off disappear from the preview too

blocks.text: Locker, Store and Friends in game

blocks.caption: The Locker, laid out like in the launcher.

items: **Locker** like in the launcher: **one click** to wear, **right click** for everything else
Show or hide your **armour** in the preview, and save looks as **loadouts**
The **Store** got the launcher's look too
**Friends** is one window now: requests, party and chat in one place
**You're back in your own recordings** - also in ones you already made - and in the players list, with your pet following you
Recording **keeps going** when a server moves you (lobby to arena and back)
**Better Tab List** rolls open and closed (switch it off with *Open Animation*)
**Launcher Doctor** fixes more crashes for you: Sodium and Iris versions that don't fit, the Windows narrator, Smart App Control blocking the sound library, and shader packs that don't work on Vulkan
Old Java 8 launch options no longer stop the game from starting
The AFK frame limit can be switched off, and chunks no longer reload when Performance Boost changes its preset
Performance Boost shows your average in-game FPS
A faster HUD, and server messages about blocked modules show only once per server
Lots of small fixes in the Locker, Store, profile pages and bug reports

blocks.text: Something not right? Use **Report a bug** in the launcher - we read every report.
